senses.gloss: pl. (benignae, sub. interpretationes, opp. durae, v. Harper’s Lat. Dict. 1882) favorable side, mitigating circumstances.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:6">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אבקש ב׳ שלהם</he> ed. (Ms. <he>בנו׳</he>; Ar. <he>בנינגי</he>, taking <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite> for a servile letter as do the commentaries) I shall search for what can be found in their favor.
